description: Publish a profile live. Publish a profile to the CDN — rebuild its KV snapshot + purge the edge. Publishing is PROFILE-WIDE: the whole profile is snapshotted into one KV blob, so the body takes no options.

profileId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: i18n_profiles_publish
